quick_skim.title: Region Aware Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks for Image Segmentation
quick_skim.abstract: Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) modules improve convolutional networks by modeling channel-wise dependencies, but global average pooling collapses spatial structure into a single per-channel descriptor, limiting their effectiveness for dense prediction tasks such as image segmentation. We generalize SE by replacing global pooling with spatially guided pooling, enabling region-aware channel recalibration through four modules with complementary cost profiles. BASE formalizes Tiled Squeeze-and-Excite using a regular grid; SPASE pools over SLIC superpixels for image-adaptive regions; MAPSE obtains regions from semantic maps produced by a frozen, general-purpose network; and PLEASE learns soft region assignments end-to-end through a lightweight assignment network. Each channel receives one gate per region, so attention at each pixel reflects its region membership, bridging channel and spatial attention. PLEASE also produces its soft assignments as a byproduct of the forward pass, providing structured spatial interpretability without post-hoc analysis. The modules offer complementary computational tradeoffs: some add essentially no parameters, while others add no measurable latency. Across binary segmentation on CUB, DUTS, and ECSSD, semantic segmentation on PASCAL VOC 2012 and ADE20K, and classification on mini-ImageNet, our modules outperform SE and related spatial-channel attention variants on most benchmarks, achieving the majority of best results.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 现有Squeeze-and-Excitation模块通过全局平均池化把空间结构压缩为单一通道描述子，限制了其在图像分割等稠密预测任务中的效果。本文提出区域感知的SE模块，用空间引导池化替代全局池化，给出网格划分、超像素、语义图和可学习软区域四种形式，实现区域级通道重校准。实验表明该方法在分割任务上带来提升，并提供不同计算代价的模块选择，为分割网络的通道注意力设计提供了更灵活方案。

quick_skim.title: Hybrid supervised instance segmentation by learning label noise suppression
quick_skim.abstract: To reach top accuracy, current fully supervised instance segmentation methods severely rely on large-scale pixel-wise labeled datasets. They are usually expensive and time-consuming to obtain. Though weakly or semi-supervised methods utilize cheap bounding box labeled, image-level labeled or unlabeled samples to save the labeling cost, their performance is largely sacrificed. To save labeling cost without losing much performance, in this paper, we present a pipeline that can utilize economical bounding box labels and accurate pixel-wise labels in a hybrid way. Specifically, we design two ancillary models to learn label noise suppression and obtain accurate pseudo pixel-wise labels from bounding box labels for training. One is designed to suppress mislabeling between foreground and background, and the other is designed to suppress noise from mislabeling of instances. Moreover, we exploit category-aware spatial attention module, category constraint module, instance constraint module, and self-learning training approach to improve the accuracy of pseudo labels. Experiments on the PASCAL VOC 2012 and the Cityscapes datasets show that our method can achieve competitive performance with much less labeling cost.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Fully supervised instance segmentation relies on costly pixel-level labels while weak/semi-supervised methods sacrifice accuracy. This paper proposes a hybrid pipeline using economical bounding-box labels plus accurate pixel labels, with two ancillary models suppressing label noise to derive accurate pseudo pixel-wise masks for training.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 当前全监督实例分割严重依赖大规模像素级标注，成本高昂，而弱监督或半监督方法虽节省标注却大幅损失精度。本文提出一种混合监督流程，同时利用廉价的边界框标签与少量精确像素标签，并设计两个辅助模型进行标签噪声抑制，从框标注中获取准确的伪像素级掩码用于训练。该方法在节省标注成本的同时尽量保持性能，为实例分割提供更经济的监督范式。

quick_skim.title: FuseAdapt: Parameter-Efficient Multimodal Fusion for Semantic Segmentation with Missing Modalities
quick_skim.abstract: Multi-modal semantic segmentation benefits from complementary sensors, but this benefit is fragile when some modalities are degraded or missing at test time. Many existing methods rely on dedicated fusion modules or multi-branch cross-modal encoders, and the fusion often becomes unreliable when modalities are absent, leading to substantial performance drops. We propose \textbf{FuseAdapt}, a parameter-efficient framework that performs fusion within the adaptation space of a frozen vision foundation model (VFM), exploring whether VFM priors can serve as an effective shared backbone for multi-modal segmentation. Instead of attaching a standalone fusion network, FuseAdapt assigns each modality a lightweight adaptation branch and performs \emph{adaptation-space fusion} by keeping Q/V low-rank adaptation private to each modality and routing only FFN low-rank residual activations across modalities inside the frozen backbone. The pretrained VFM remains fixed while modality-specific corrections and explicit cross-modal interaction are learned through the adaptation paths. To handle missing modalities, we further introduce \textbf{Predictive Modality Modeling (PMM)}, a direct representation-level objective for cross-modal redundancy. During training, PMM masks a target modality and predicts its embedding from the visible ones, supervised by a teacher target computed under full-modality input. PMM is used only during training and adds no inference-time overhead. Across three multi-modal segmentation benchmarks (MCubeS, DELIVER, MUSES), FuseAdapt consistently improves both modality-complete and modality-incomplete segmentation with a small trainable budget, yielding up to +3.01 mIoU under full modalities and +12.56 mIoU under missing modalities over prior state-of-the-art. Project page: https://devinxzhang.github.io/FuseAdapt-Page/.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: multimodal semantic segmentation with missing modalities

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: FuseAdapt performs parameter-efficient multimodal fusion inside the adaptation space of a frozen vision foundation model, making semantic segmentation robust when some modalities are degraded or missing at test time.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 多模态语义分割依赖多传感器互补，但测试时模态缺失或退化会使融合失效并导致性能骤降。FuseAdapt不改用独立融合网络，而是在冻结视觉基础模型的适配空间中为每种模态分配轻量适配分支完成融合。该框架探索基础模型先验能否作为多模态分割的共享骨干，从而在模态缺失时保持稳健。结果说明参数高效融合可缓解模态缺失带来的性能下降，对分割模型鲁棒性设计有借鉴意义。
